_about: Public-domain Jan van Ruysbroeck (1293-1381, Flemish Augustinian prior of Groenendael) in English for the Word Hoard: The Adornment of the Spiritual Marriage, The Sparkling Stone and The Book of Supreme Truth, tr. C. A. Wynschenk Dom, ed. Evelyn Underhill (1916) from CCEL, and The Book of the Twelve Beguines tr. John Francis (1913), The Kingdom of the Lovers of God tr. T. Arnold Hyde from Surius's Latin (1919) and Love's Gradatory tr. Mother St. Jerome (about 1914) from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 24 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Translators recorded per item; every printing dated or catalogued before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

ruysbroeck-adornment: The Adornment of the Spiritual Marriage; The Sparkling Stone; The Book of Supreme Truth, tr. C. A. Wynschenk Dom, ed. Evelyn Underhill (London: J. M. Dent, MCMXVI)

ruysbroeck-loves-gradatory: Love's Gradatory, tr. Mother St. Jerome (London: R. & T. Washbourne; imprimatur 1914)
